description: Source code for sound management in the Wesnoth game, including initialization, playback, and cleanup of audio resources using SDL_mixer.

classes.name: sound::manager
classes.description: Manages sound system lifecycle, including initialization and cleanup.

methods.name: init_sound
methods.description: Initializes the audio subsystem and prepares sound and music channels.

methods.name: close_sound
methods.description: Shuts down the audio subsystem and releases resources.

methods.name: stop_music
methods.description: Stops music playback and clears music cache.

methods.name: stop_sound
methods.description: Stops all sound effects and clears sound cache.

methods.name: play_music
methods.description: Plays specified music file, with fade-in if applicable.

methods.name: set_music_volume
methods.description: Sets the volume for music playback.

methods.name: set_sound_volume
methods.description: Sets the volume for sound effects.
